# TextSpan

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A styled segment of text within a RichText element. Each span carries its own TextStyle that is merged with the parent's default style at render time.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new TextSpan()
```

## Properties

- [`IsLineBreak`](#islinebreak): When true, a line break is inserted after this span's text.
- [`Link`](#link): A URI that makes this span a link: each line the span wraps onto becomes a clickable region, tagged as a Link inside the paragraph, with the span's text as its description.
- [`Style`](#style): The style for this span.
- [`Text`](#text): The text content of this span.

### `IsLineBreak`

```csharp
bool IsLineBreak { get; set; }
```

When true, a line break is inserted after this span's text.

### `Link`

```csharp
string Link { get; set; }
```

A URI that makes this span a link: each line the span wraps onto becomes a clickable region, tagged as a Link inside the paragraph, with the span's text as its description. The link's look is the span's style (colour, underline); nothing is added.

### `Style`

```csharp
TextStyle Style { get; set; }
```

The style for this span. Properties set to null inherit from the parent RichText's DefaultStyle.

### `Text`

```csharp
string Text { get; set; }
```

The text content of this span.
